reports.description: I paid ‚Ç¨250 to Investmentpro.io via moonpay (which I could afford to lose if it went wrong) and I was sent a wallet number. Unfortunately, I realised that the whole thing didnt feel right but not until after I had verified my account by sending them my jpg proof of address, ID (passport) and my bank ATM Visa card. I immediately cancelled my ATM card but now because I have had repeated calls from various numbers with even more elaborate claims of there being thousands in my wallet (which I dont have access to) I am very worried. This evening I received a message asking to confirm if I was alive because someone declaring that they have my POA was trying to claim my fund 8.5 million dollars because I apparently died in 2020 due to Covid. The email I received was from  Jones William <cabs.saudebucal@cotia.sp.gov.br but it bounces back as wasnt found at the destination domain. I am of course very concerned that I inadvertently (and very stupidly) gave my personal details so the scammers can steal my identity. So tomorrow I will speak to the UK passport office to seek advice to get a new passport. In the meantime, is it possible to find out if the supposed wallet I was given and had paid 250 into, still exists and is it being operated behind my back as it were to make a profit for a criminal who is using my ID. I am very concerned that a crime is being carried out that I might be held accountable for.
